claim: Anvil Services (Anvil International), 417 Elizabeth Ave, Somerset
problem: Google's own place name is "Anvil International, LLC - DBA - Anvil Services" - a corporate site of a national pipe-fittings manufacturer (ASC Engineered Solutions), not an independent local business. The mapper flagged it as borderline and included it, while excluding similar branch operations (LGE US, Ferguson, Terumo).
fix: Remove, or reclassify as a branch of a national company and apply the chain exclusion consistently across the whole list.

fix: Add Somerset Taekwondo (1075 Easton Ave #13), Warrior Martial Arts Somerset (34 Worlds Fair Dr), New Journey MMA (2 JFK Blvd), Young Moo Martial Arts (120 Cedar Grove Ln), Golden Warrior Self Defense (24 Susan Dr) after township checks.

problem: The mapper's own category has gaps: Jem Dry Cleaners (225 Demott Ln #5) and La Ritz Cleaners (120 Cedar Grove Ln) are in-zone, independently owned and missing, while four similar cleaners were listed. The mapper's dry-cleaner entries were harvested under a 'tailor alterations' query, which is why the plain dry-cleaner category is under-covered.

problem: MRP Solutions, MICRO, United Plastics Group, Betar Inc and Ardena US are multi-site or corporate-owned plants (the mapper itself flags size/ownership doubts for three of them) but were kept, while LGE US, Ferguson and Terumo were excluded on the same reasoning. claim: Food-adjacent B2B entries vs the 'food' exclusion
problem: Ziyad Distribution (food import/distribution warehouse) and W. A. Cleary Corporation (Google category 'Food manufacturer') are B2B food operations. Judgment call: the exclusion most likely targets restaurants/retail food, but the mapper did not state which reading it used.
fix: Confirm the intended scope of the food exclusion with the orchestrator and keep or drop both consistently.
